EXT.evidence: States a preference to keep a safe distance from all the merriment and tells another person to stop “shooping,” showing withdrawal from group fun.

AGR.evidence: Criticizes others’ behavior (tells someone to stop and declares that throwing food is not funny anymore), showing low accommodation.

CON.evidence: Discourages messy, disruptive behavior (food throwing) and keeps a safe distance to maintain order and safety.

NEU.evidence: Emphasizes keeping a “safe distance” from the merriment and reacts irritably to chaos, indicating sensitivity/wariness.

OPN.evidence: Rejects playful, novel behavior (food throwing, ‘shooping’) and adopts a cautious stance instead.
